why: The experiment budget is exhausted. Preserve the best evaluated candidate: chord errors fell from baseline 30/38 to 25/38, but melody error rose from 87/130 to 130/130 and no complete files parsed. Later integration branches produced no improvement; GTK loading was verified only outside Java, and export timed out without predictions. The goal remains unmet: only seven of 32 excerpts were tested, chord timing is unaudited, musician review is absent, and actual-output transposition remains unverified.
hypothesis: The initial OCR stage offers a limited chord-label improvement, but no tested approach establishes a usable image-to-editable-kern workflow.
expected_observation: Retain the initial candidate as partial development evidence, with failed integration branches preserved and no completion or held-out accuracy claim.
